name: SwapNet Router arbitrary call
summary: The closed-source SwapNet Router's swap entrypoint (selector 0x87395540) performed a low-level call to a caller-supplied target with caller-supplied calldata and no target validation, so passing a token address made the router itself execute transferFrom() against users' standing infinite approvals.
notes: The last of four pre-incident Upgraded events selected the defect-bearing implementation; its address is the first word of event data.

Matcha reports $13.43 million taken from 18 SwapNet users across Base, BNB Chain, and Arbitrum. The selected Base transaction records 13,342,433.169249 USDC transferred from one victim to the attacker; the structured asset is this directly observed component of the reported campaign total.

The $13.43 million loss is Matcha's rounded campaign estimate across Base, BNB Chain, and Arbitrum; only the selected Base transaction's 13,342,433.169249 USDC component is structured from direct onchain evidence.
